title: com.docker.sandbox/mcp-server@1
description: Declares that a workload's image is an MCP server: the host attaches it to a sandbox's MCP gateway, starting the image's own entrypoint, rather than launching it as a sandbox. Singleton, workload-only, never optional or a group member. name, transport, port, and path are literal; arguments may reference kit args. The entry grants no permission; the server's reach is its own network-policy and credential entries.

name.description: Name the gateway serves this server under: one lowercase DNS label.

transport.description: How the entrypoint speaks MCP: on its standard streams, or as a streamable-HTTP endpoint at port and path.

port.description: Container port the streamable-HTTP endpoint listens on. Required for streamable-http, forbidden for stdio.

path.description: Absolute URL path of the streamable-HTTP endpoint, without query or fragment, and with % only as a two-hex-digit escape. Forbidden for stdio.

arguments.description: Argv the entrypoint runs with in place of the image's cmd, as `docker run <image> <args>` would pass it. Elements are strings and may reference ${{ kit.args.<name> }} but not kit.env; quote numbers and booleans, which YAML would otherwise decode and re-spell. Omit it to run the image's cmd.
